mapper.update: UPDATE t_delivery SET dispatch_seq = #{dispatchSeq}, vehicle_seq = #{vehicleSeq}, driver_seq = #{driverSeq}, region_seq = #{regionSeq}, delivery_order = #{deliveryOrder}, tracking_num = #{trackingNum}, recipient_name = #{recipientName}, recipient_phone_num = #{recipientPhoneNum}, delivery_postal_code = #{deliveryPostalCode}, delivery_addr_1 = #{deliveryAddr1}, delivery_addr_2 = #{deliveryAddr2}, delivery_type_cd = #{deliveryTypeCd}, product_name = #{productName}, box_count = #{boxCount}, memo = #{memo}, security_code = #{securityCode}, pickup_datetime = #{pickupDatetime}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, delivery_status_cd = #{deliveryStatusCd}, delivery_estimated_start_time = #{deliveryEstimatedStartTime}, delivery_estimated_end_time = #{deliveryEstimatedEndTime}, delivery_datetime = #{deliveryDatetime}, shooting_impossible_yn = #{shootingImpossibleYn}, shooting_impossible_reason_cd = #{shootingImpossibleReasonCd}, consignment_location_cd = #{consignmentLocationCd}, uncompleted_reason_cd = #{uncompletedReasonCd}, delivery_photo_attach_seq = #{deliveryPhotoAttachSeq}, modified_at = #{modifiedAt}, modifier_seq = #{modifierSeq} WHERE delivery_seq = #{deliverySeq}
mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM ( SELECT a.delivery_seq, a.vehicle_seq, b.vehicle_name, c.driver_name, a.region_seq, d.region_name, a.delivery_order, a.tracking_num, a.recipient_name, a.recipient_phone_num, a.delivery_postal_code, a.delivery_addr_1, a.delivery_addr_2, a.delivery_type_cd, (SELECT com_code_name FROM t_common_code WHERE com_code_group_cd = 'DeliveryType' AND com_code_cd = a.delivery_type_cd) AS delivery_type_cd_name, a.product_name, a.box_count, a.memo, a.security_code, a.latitude, a.longitude, a.delivery_status_cd, (SELECT com_code_name FROM t_common_code WHERE com_code_group_cd = 'DeliveryStatus' AND com_code_cd = a.delivery_status_cd) AS delivery_status_cd_name, a.pickup_datetime, a.delivery_estimated_start_time, a.delivery_estimated_end_time, a.delivery_datetime, a.shooting_impossible_yn, a.shooting_impossible_reason_cd, (SELECT com_code_name FROM t_common_code WHERE com_code_group_cd = 'ShootingImpossibleReason' AND com_code_cd = a.shooting_impossible_reason_cd) AS shooting_impossible_reason_cd_name, a.consignment_location_cd, (SELECT com_code_name FROM t_common_code WHERE com_code_group_cd = 'ConsignmentLocation' AND com_code_cd = a.consignment_location_cd) AS consignment_location_cd_name, a.uncompleted_reason_cd, (SELECT com_code_name FROM t_common_code WHERE com_code_group_cd = 'UncompletedReason' AND com_code_cd = a.uncompleted_reason_cd) AS uncompleted_reason_cd_name, a.delivery_photo_attach_seq, e.original_file_name AS delivery_photo_file_name, e.file_full_path AS delivery_photo_full_path, a.created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY a.delivery_seq ORDER BY e.sort_order) AS attach_file_sort_order FROM t_delivery a LEFT JOIN t_vehicle b ON a.vehicle_seq = b.vehicle_seq LEFT JOIN t_driver c ON a.driver_seq = c.driver_seq LEFT JOIN t_region d ON a.region_seq = d.region_seq LEFT JOIN t_file e ON a.delivery_photo_attach_seq = e.attach_seq WHERE a.dispatch_seq = #{dispatchSeq} ) a WHERE a.attach_file_sort_order = 1
SELECT MAX(tracking_num) FROM t_delivery WHERE tracking_num LIKE #{trackingNum} || '%'
SELECT tracking_num FROM t_delivery WHERE tracking_num = #{trackingNum}
SELECT MAX(delivery_order) FROM t_delivery WHERE dispatch_seq = #{dispatchSeq}

SELECT MIN(dispatch_seq) AS dispatch_seq, SUM(total_count) AS total_count, SUM(delivery_total_count) AS delivery_total_count, SUM(delivery_total_completed_count) AS delivery_total_completed_count, SUM(delivery_completed_count) AS delivery_completed_count, SUM(delivery_uncompleted_count) AS delivery_uncompleted_count, SUM(collection_total_count) AS collection_total_count, SUM(collection_total_completed_count) AS collection_total_completed_count, SUM(collection_completed_count) AS collection_completed_count, SUM(collection_uncompleted_count) AS collection_uncompleted_count FROM ( SELECT a.dispatch_seq, a.box_count AS total_count, CASE WHEN delivery_type_cd = 'DELIVERY' THEN a.box_count ELSE 0 END AS delivery_total_count, CASE WHEN delivery_type_cd = 'DELIVERY' AND delivery_status_cd IN ('COMPLETED', 'UNCOMPLETED') THEN a.box_count ELSE 0 END AS delivery_total_completed_count, CASE WHEN delivery_type_cd = 'DELIVERY' AND delivery_status_cd = 'COMPLETED' THEN a.box_count ELSE 0 END AS delivery_completed_count, CASE WHEN delivery_type_cd = 'DELIVERY' AND delivery_status_cd = 'UNCOMPLETED' THEN a.box_count ELSE 0 END AS delivery_uncompleted_count, CASE WHEN delivery_type_cd = 'COLLECTION' THEN a.box_count ELSE 0 END AS collection_total_count, CASE WHEN delivery_type_cd = 'COLLECTION' AND delivery_status_cd IN ('COMPLETED', 'UNCOMPLETED') THEN a.box_count ELSE 0 END AS collection_total_completed_count, CASE WHEN delivery_type_cd = 'COLLECTION' AND delivery_status_cd = 'COMPLETED' THEN a.box_count ELSE 0 END AS collection_completed_count, CASE WHEN delivery_type_cd = 'COLLECTION' AND delivery_status_cd = 'UNCOMPLETED' THEN a.box_count ELSE 0 END AS collection_uncompleted_count FROM t_delivery a WHERE a.driver_seq = #{driverSeq} AND a.dispatch_seq = #{dispatchSeq} ) a
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_delivery a INNER JOIN t_dispatch b ON a.dispatch_seq = b.dispatch_seq WHERE a.vehicle_seq = #{vehicleSeq} AND b.dispatch_status_cd != 'DELIVERY_COMPLETED' /*배송완료가 아닌 배차데이터 조회*/
mapper.sql: SELECT a.delivery_date, a.total_count, a.completed_count, a.delivery_completed_count, a.delivery_uncompleted_count, a.collection_completed_count, a.collection_uncompleted_count, CASE WHEN a.total_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC((a.completed_count / a.total_count) * 100, 2) END AS process_ratio, CASE WHEN a.work_start_datetime IS NULL OR a.work_end_datetime IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE TRUNC(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM a.work_end_datetime - a.work_start_datetime) / 60) END AS work_minutes FROM ( SELECT b.delivery_date, SUM(a.box_count) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.delivery_status_cd = 'COMPLETED' THEN a.box_count ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.delivery_type_cd = 'DELIVERY' AND a.delivery_status_cd = 'COMPLETED' THEN a.box_count ELSE 0 END) AS delivery_completed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.delivery_type_cd = 'DELIVERY' AND a.delivery_status_cd != 'COMPLETED' THEN a.box_count ELSE 0 END) AS delivery_uncompleted_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.delivery_type_cd = 'COLLECTION' AND a.delivery_status_cd = 'COMPLETED' THEN a.box_count ELSE 0 END) AS collection_completed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.delivery_type_cd = 'COLLECTION' AND a.delivery_status_cd != 'COMPLETED' THEN a.box_count ELSE 0 END) AS collection_uncompleted_count, MIN(( SELECT x.created_at FROM t_delivery_history x WHERE x.delivery_seq = x.delivery_seq AND x.delivery_status_cd = 'INSPECTION_COMPLETED' /*검수완료*/ ORDER BY x.created_at ASC LIMIT 1 )) AS work_start_datetime, MAX(( SELECT x.created_at FROM t_delivery_history x WHERE x.delivery_seq = x.delivery_seq AND x.delivery_status_cd = 'COMPLETED' /*배송완료*/ ORDER BY x.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 )) AS work_end_datetime FROM t_delivery a INNER JOIN t_dispatch b ON a.dispatch_seq = b.dispatch_seq WHERE a.driver_seq = #{driverSeq} AND b.delivery_date BETWEEN #{deliveryStartDate} AND #{deliveryEndDate} GROUP BY b.delivery_date ) a

SELECT CASE WHEN a.inspection_waiting_count > 0 THEN 'INSPECTION_WAITING' WHEN a.inspection_completed_count > 0 THEN 'INSPECTION_COMPLETED' WHEN a.in_delivery_count > 0 THEN 'IN_DELIVERY' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END driver_delivery_status FROM ( SELECT SUM(CASE a.delivery_status_cd WHEN 'INSPECTION_WAITING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inspection_waiting_count, SUM(CASE a.delivery_status_cd WHEN 'INSPECTION_COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inspection_completed_count, SUM(CASE a.delivery_status_cd WHEN 'IN_DELIVERY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_delivery_count, SUM(CASE a.delivery_status_cd WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count, SUM(CASE a.delivery_status_cd WHEN 'UNCOMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uncompleted_count FROM t_delivery a WHERE a.driver_seq = #{driverSeq} AND a.dispatch_seq = #{dispatchSeq} ) a
